This script draws the Kaplan–Meier curves for survival in the matched cohort by HIV status, overall and before and after the DAA era, with risk tables, and runs the log-rank tests.

::: Rcode
### Source code

The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/figures/figures.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/blob/master/R/figures/figures.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following helper files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/blob/master/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/HIV-SLK-outcomes/blob/master/R/functions/functions.R)
:::
